subject: INTEGER-OF-DAY function
notes: Same rule text, same §15.5.2 content, reached through §15.47.3 r1's Julian argument '(YYYY * 1000) + DDD': 1601001 -> 1, 9999365 -> 3067671 (9999 is not a leap year, so its ordinal year ends at 365 and that day is 9999-12-31), 1604060 -> 1155, 2000060 -> 145791, 1700059 -> 36218, 1700060 -> 36219, 1995046 -> 143951. Ordinal day 60 landing on a different calendar date in 1700 than in 1604 or 2000 is where §15.5.1's century branch bites hardest, and all three are printed.
